messages:
michelle: Hey team — Acme Health POC going to legal. They need HIPAA + SOC2, KMS/HSM key control, and 7-year audit log retention. POC scope: 2 dedicated pods (4x A100 equiv) for 6 weeks, then a pilot. They asked for any commit pricing or discounts we can offer. timeline: kickoff in 2 weeks.
sam: +1. Please capture expected ACV and if they can commit to reserved capacity after POC. Link to public rate card: https://redwood.example/ratecard (internal only).
david: For the POC we can spin a private demo env in their VPC (or our Private product). Technical notes: enable per-route audit logging, KV cache persisted to encrypted storage, and we can configure BYOK with HSM-backed keys. POC perf baseline: ~8k tok/s across 2 pods depending on model.
michelle: ACV estimate is $180k (12mo pilot -> potential expansion). They want a discount if we include compliance add-ons bundled.
sam: Baseline add-on pricing (internal reference):
- HIPAA + SOC2 package (DPA, intake, attestation support): $2,500/mo or one-time enterprise onboarding $8,000 for legal work.
- KMS/HSM integration: one-time setup $12,000 (HSM provisioning + attestation), ongoing $1,200/mo for HSM management + $0.10/operation for HSM sign ops (est).
- Audit log long-term retention (7yr): tiered pricing: first 90 days included, cold storage $0.02/GB/mo thereafter; for compliance package we offer managed retrieval @ $0.05/GB. We also offer a flat archival bundle: $1,800/mo for up to 50GB/month archived data.
- Enhanced retention & SIEM ingestion: optional connector $600/mo.
Note: numbers are internal and need Deal Desk approval for customer-facing quote.
lina: Security checklist: will require completed security questionnaire, penetration test attestation, and proof of SAAS controls for HIPAA flow. HSM approach: prefer customer BYOK with a validated HSM. If they want Redwood-managed HSM, we need SOC2 appendix and extra procurement timeline.
priya: For discounting — our standard deal desk thresholds: 10% for 12mo commit >= $20k/mo; 20% for >= $50k/mo; >25% requires VP approval. For one-off compliance packaging discounts, provide target margin and I'll submit. Also need the legal DPA/PSA SOW draft.
michelle: They're asking for a 15% discount on list if we include HIPAA + 2yr log retention. Can we do that under standard thresholds?
tom_finance: 15% is between 10% and 20% — needs SR-level approval unless you can shift to a product bundle with committed spend. If ACV is $180k over 12mo that's $15k/mo, which is below the 10% threshold. If we can get them to commit $20k/mo (buy more capacity) we hit 10%.
priya: Actionable: Michelle, can you confirm expected committed monthly spend post-POC? If they can sign for $20k/mo commit we can offer 10% plus waive onboarding fee for HIPAA. For 15% we need a business justification (strategic account + reference) and VP sign-off.
david: On the technical presales side I can join the security call with Acme's infra team next Tue. I can prepare a short runbook showing audit log export, KMS BYOK flow, and how we isolate PHI in the pipeline.
michelle: I'll push for $20k/mo commit and ask for reference case. Can you draft the runbook and a slide for legal explaining data flow?
david: Yep. I'll attach the runbook to the deal thread after the call.
sam: I'll prepare an internal package (rate card + add-on price list + suggested bundle) and create a Deal Desk request (will include margin, comps, and recommended approval level). Expect the submission to Priya by EOD tomorrow.
priya: Once submitted, Deal Desk turnaround for this complexity is ~48-72 hours. If VP approval is needed, add another 48h. Please mark the request as "compliance-bundle".
dealbot: Deal Desk request created: #DD-4832 by sam. Status: pending docs.
michelle: Thanks — scheduling security call with Acme infra for Tue 10am PT and the exec sponsor on Wed. I'll capture ACV/commit updates after calls.
lina: I'll review the security questionnaire draft pre-call. If they need penetration tests, we may request a signed NDA before exchanging details.
priya: One more note on quoting: when including HSM/BYOK, we put a one-time engineering onboarding fee line item and a monthly managed-key fee. For customer-managed HSM (their HSM), waiver on managed-key fee but we charge an integration engineering fee (~$6k).
michelle: Perfect. Will confirm and update. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
